items.title: Could Coherent (COHR) Gain From New US Limits On Chinese Data Center Gear?
items.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) is in focus after reports that the US plans to curb imports of Chinese data center gear. Forthcoming limits on Chinese optical transceivers, tied to security concerns, could redirect orders toward US based suppliers. As a major domestic producer of optical components, Coherent could see more interest from cloud and telecom customers seeking US sourcing. Potential US curbs on Chinese optical transceivers are only one part of how policy is reshaping Coherent's outlook...
